_doc: Companions (design/people/people-and-side-activities-spec.md §4.4; build item N-7.6.6). One walks with you at a time: ask with Walk with me (the story's `companion <who> join`, once `gate` holds; a story condition, Close at least) and send them home with Part (`companion <who> part`). They follow you on every map. role: guard (in a fight, when you're Staggered or under `guard_hp` of your Vitality, every `guard_every` s they shove the nearest enemy off you), cutter (every `cut_every` s they cut short one enemy's wind-up near you), guide (no fight kit: they stay out of it). strike: their own blow at the nearest enemy near you ({every s, dmg, impact, reach px}); what they finish trains nothing of yours. They fight only in 1 vs many (never in a duel: an encounter with `hits`). A fight won together is the `walk` bond (bonds.json). perk: road sense while they walk with you (rumour: one rumour on first reaching a region each season; text says it). talks: night talks, in order: after a night's sleep, the next one not yet heard plays as you wake (one a night).

wren.perk_text: Wren hears things. Reach a region for the first time this season and she passes one on.
